ai.enter_project_key: Enter an API key for this project

permissions.open_workspace: Open a workspace to configure agent permissions.
permissions.title: Agent Permissions
permissions.description: Manage which commands the AI agent can run in this project. Approved patterns are saved to .claude/settings.local.json and shared with Claude Code CLI.
permissions.trusted_desc: The AI agent can run commands in this workspace.
permissions.untrusted_desc: Trust this workspace to allow the AI agent to run commands.
permissions.agent_verified_checks: Pause risky operations such as deploys and destructive commands for confirmation with Agent-verified checks.
permissions.ask_desc: Agent asks before running commands. Approvals saved to .claude/settings.local.json.
permissions.allow_edits_desc: File operations auto-approved. Bash and web requests follow Claude Code settings.
permissions.allow_all_desc: All operations auto-approved without any prompts.
permissions.classifier: Run an AI safety classifier on risky operations (Claude Code). When on, deploys and other destructive commands prompt for confirmation instead of running silently.
permissions.additional_desc: Allow the agent to access directories outside this project.
permissions.no_additional: No additional directories. The agent can only access files within this project.
permissions.allowed_urls_desc: Allow the agent to fetch or curl specific domains. Use wildcards like *.github.com to allow all subdomains.
permissions.all_domains_desc: The agent can fetch from any URL without asking.
permissions.no_urls: No URL patterns allowed yet. The agent will ask before making web requests.
permissions.no_patterns: No patterns allowed yet. When you approve a command, its pattern will appear here.
permissions.error_all_domains: Failed to revoke all domains permission

tools.title: Tools & MCP
tools.description: See what the agent's tools cost in context tokens and control which groups it can load.
tools.group_desc_nimbalyst: Host glue the app needs (questions, commit proposal, screenshots, session metadata)
tools.group_desc_host: App settings, session context, and child-session orchestration
tools.group_desc_trackers: Bug, task, plan, and decision tracking
tools.group_desc_situational: Voice mode, collab documents, and feedback
tools.required_tool: Required — the app's own tools; cannot be disabled
tools.token_external_title: Tool definitions live in the external server; cost unknown until it connects
tools.token_estimated_title: Estimated context tokens when this group's tool definitions are loaded
tools.baseline: Every session starts with only the Core tools loaded ({{tokens}} tokens). All other groups stay out of the context window until the agent actually needs them, so their costs below are only paid on demand. The live breakdown for a running session is on the token meter in the AI panel.
tools.footer: Changes apply to your next message — no restart needed.

org.not_linked: This workspace isn’t linked to an organization yet. Create or join a team from the Team panel; its members, roles, and project access will appear here.
org.description: Org roles grant org-wide capability; owners and admins implicitly administer every project. Members and guests get exactly their per-project grant.
org.billing_note: Billing, SSO, and domain settings are managed at the organization level and will move here.
org.confirm_remove: Remove {{member}} from "{{org}}"? They will lose access to every project in this organization. This cannot be undone (you would need to invite them again).

team.server_managed_description: Team data is encrypted in transit and at rest with keys managed by Nimbalyst. This is separate from Personal sync encryption, whose keys remain only on your devices.
team.pricing: Nimbalyst Teams is free during alpha. We plan to introduce a paid subscription tier for teams in the future; existing teams will get advance notice before any pricing change.
team.encryption_description: Team data (trackers and documents) is encrypted in transit and at rest and isolated per team. Depending on your team's setup, encryption keys are either held only by members' devices, or managed by Nimbalyst so the team is reachable from the web, CLI, and cloud agents.
team.encryption_bullet_authorized: Only authorized team members can access shared data
team.encryption_bullet_personal: Your personal device sync (sessions, drafts, settings) stays zero-knowledge — keys never leave your devices
team.encryption_bullet_self_host: Need true zero-knowledge for team data? Self-hosting is the answer
team.identity_changed: This member's identity key has changed since you last verified it. Verify their new fingerprint before trusting data from them.
team.compare_fingerprint: Compare this fingerprint with {{member}} out-of-band (e.g., in person or via a secure channel) to verify their identity.
team.reshare_title: Re-share the encryption key with this member (e.g., after they changed devices)
team.personal_project: This project is personal. Create a team to share tracker items, documents, and collaborate in real time.
team.create_team_description: Team members can collaborate on shared tracker items and documents.
team.account_note: The team will be created under this account.
team.git_remote_hint: Any team member who opens a clone of this repo will be automatically connected.
team.encryption_key_description: A unique encryption key will be generated for this team. Keys are shared securely via ECDH exchange when members join.
team.add_existing_description: Already have an organization? Add this repo as a new project under it instead of creating a separate team. It joins as its own tracker space, sharing the organization's members and encryption.
team.no_git_remote_add: This workspace has no git remote, so it cannot be added as a project.
team.project_identity_description: Teams are linked to a git remote, so any member who opens a clone of the same repo is automatically connected.
team.team_project_identity_description: Teams are linked to a git remote. Members who open a clone of the same repo are automatically connected.
team.multiple_projects_description: This organization has multiple projects. Each is its own tracker space; members share the organization's roster and encryption.
team.move_project_title: Move this project to another organization
team.your_fingerprint_description: Share this fingerprint with your team members so they can verify your identity.
team.merge_title: Move all of this organization's projects into another organization you administer
team.invited_to_join: You have been invited to join this team. Accept to collaborate on shared, encrypted tracker items and documents.
team.team_description: Create a team to collaborate on shared, encrypted tracker items and documents.
team.sign_in_create: Sign in to create or join a team.
team.go_to_sidebar: Go to {{account}} in the sidebar to sign in.
team.confirm_remove_member: Remove {{member}} from {{team}}? They will lose access to this team's shared trackers and documents. This cannot be undone (you would need to invite them again).
team.confirm_unlink: Stop syncing this project with {{team}}? Its trackers and documents will no longer sync to the team. You can re-link it later.
team.confirm_delete: Permanently delete team {{team}}? This will remove all members, shared documents, and encryption keys. This action cannot be undone.
team.error_add_project: Failed to add project to organization
team.h2_server_status: Real-time team collaboration on · encrypted & isolated per team
team.h2_update_description: Enable real-time collaboration, web, CLI, and AI agents for your team.
team.h2_member_notice: Your team admin needs to update encryption settings to enable web, CLI, and AI-agent access for this team. Your personal data stays end-to-end encrypted either way.
team.h2_server_description: Team trackers and documents are encrypted at rest and in transit, isolated per team, with keys managed by Nimbalyst — reachable from the desktop app, web, CLI, and AI agents. Your personal sync (sessions, drafts, settings) stays end-to-end encrypted.
team.h2_repair_description: Re-share the current team key with every member. Fixes teammates seeing “Encrypted document (key unavailable)”. Run this from a device that can read the team’s shared content.
team.h2_no_workspace: No workspace is linked to this team; open the team’s project first.
team.h2_modal_description: This turns on real-time team collaboration — including from the web, CLI, and AI agents — by letting Nimbalyst manage this team’s shared encryption keys instead of only your devices. Your personal data (sessions, drafts, settings) stays end-to-end encrypted.
team.h2_acknowledge: Nimbalyst will manage this team’s shared encryption keys to enable real-time collaboration — no longer zero-knowledge. My personal data stays end-to-end encrypted.
team.h2_admin_only: Only a team owner or admin can migrate the team.
team.h2_migration_error: Migration could not complete: {{error}}. Your team is still end-to-end encrypted. You can retry.
team.h2_reencrypting: Re-encrypting your team’s trackers and documents…
team.h2_reencrypting_description: Your existing team data is being re-encrypted under the new model. This can take a moment; keep Nimbalyst open until it finishes.
team.h2_done_description: Your team can now collaborate in real time from the web, CLI, and AI agents.
team.h2_items_reencrypted: {{count}} tracker item(s) are being re-encrypted in the background.
team.h2_personal_sync: Your personal sync stays end-to-end encrypted.
team.h2_redistributed: Re-distributed the team key to {{count}} member(s){{failedNote}}. Affected members should reopen the workspace.
team.move_description: Moving {{project}} relocates its trackers, documents, and member access into another organization. The originals are removed from this org.
team.move_no_candidates: You don't own or administer another organization to move this project into.
team.move_encryption_description: This move needs both organizations on server-managed encryption. Update this team's encryption (Security & Encryption) before moving the project.
team.move_slug_collision: A project with this name already exists in {{name}}. Both will coexist; deep links may be ambiguous.
team.move_running: Moving project… relocating trackers, documents, and access.
team.move_uncheck: Uncheck to drop this member from the destination
team.move_no_email_transfer: No email on record — cannot transfer

trust_toast.setup_subtitle: Choose how much your coding agents can do on their own. You can change this anytime.

trust_toast.choice_allow_everything_description: No prompts, no checks — every action runs immediately. For projects you fully trust.
trust_toast.choice_allow_edits_only_description: File edits run automatically; shell commands and web requests ask first.
trust_toast.choice_ask_every_time_description: Approve each action before it runs. Your approvals are remembered.
trust_toast.footnote_before: Agents can run this project's code. If you don't recognize where this project came from,
trust_toast.title: Trust "{{project}}"?
trust_toast.subtitle: This project wants to use the AI agent
trust_toast.warning: Untrusted projects can contain malicious code. Only trust projects from sources you know.
trust_toast.choose_mode: Choose how the agent handles tool calls in this project:
trust_toast.ask_description: The agent will ask for permission before running commands. When you approve, your choices are saved to .claude/settings.local.json for future sessions.
trust_toast.with_claude_cli: with Claude Code CLI in this project
trust_toast.allow_edits_description: The agent will run all file and edit operations without asking. Shell commands and web requests may still require approval.
trust_toast.allow_edits_bullet: All file read/write/edit operations are automatically approved
trust_toast.bash_bullet: Bash commands and web fetches follow Claude Code settings
trust_toast.trust_bullet: Only use with projects you fully trust
trust_toast.allow_all_description: The agent will run all operations without permission prompts, including shell commands, file operations, and web requests.
trust_toast.allow_all_bullet: All tool calls are automatically approved
trust_toast.nimbalyst_permissions: Uses Nimbalyst permissions instead of Claude Code settings
trust_toast.development_bullet: Best for development and testing workflows

trust_toast.classifier_description: — review risky operations like deploys and prompt for confirmation instead of running them silently.

workspace.subtitle: AI-native, interactive work platform
workspace.rename_warning_title: This will rename the project folder on disk
workspace.rename_warning_desc: All AI session history, file history, and settings will be migrated. This may take a while for large projects.
workspace.move_warning_title: This will move the entire project folder
workspace.move_warning_desc: All project files will be copied to the new location, and all AI session history, file history, and settings will be migrated. This may take a while for large projects.
workspace.welcome_description: Projects are local folders on your computer. Open any folder to view and edit all markdown files within it. If you are working on a coding project, it is recommended to open the root folder of your project as agents are configured at the project level.
